description: The pie chart represents the distribution of time costs associated with a particular process, comparing the proportions of "Reduction" and "Efficient deployment". The chart is divided into two slices. The larger slice, labeled "Reduction", is colored orange and accounts for approximately 69.92% of the total, while the smaller slice, labeled "Efficient deployment", is colored blue and represents around 30.08%. The percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, along with corresponding time values. One slice is visually emphasized by being offset or "exploded" from the rest of the chart, specifically the "Efficient deployment" slice. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not ordered in a particular way beyond their relative sizes.
caption_used: Efficient deployment methods significantly reduce the time cost, with the average total time cost before efficient deployment being 92.5s (30.5s + 62s). This represents a reduction of approximately 72.5% after efficient deployment, highlighting the substantial impact of optimization strategies.
